close_reason: Replaced (task spec) with (seed.rs ts::DAYS_AGO_N) concrete references
description: In crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/seed_fixture_tests.rs, several oracle comments cite '(task spec)' as the source for expected values, e.g. 'receivedAt = daysAgo(30) from baseline 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (task spec)'. 'Task spec' is internal project-management language with no meaning to an external contributor; it doesn't point to any file, RFC section, or public document. A new contributor cannot verify these values against any external source. Distinct from bx3z.51 (line number drift). Fix: replace '(task spec)' with a concrete reference, e.g. the seed.rs ts:: constant name, or the jmap-test-suite URL and commit.
title: seed_fixture_tests.rs: 'task spec' oracle citation is opaque
